levels.mapping: Displayed utterance / UTTERANCE_OBSERVED; no required Epistemic label. Unparsed content has no finite semantic support certificate.
levels.next_turn: YES, only acknowledged displayed text with speaker/mode/entity
levels.working_context: YES as attributed utterance, not fact
levels.memory_observation: ONLY independently admitted observation of actual utterance
levels.user_fact: NO; user reported X may be recorded as report only
levels.evidence: Actual transcript/delivery for the speech event; content support is separate
levels.host_admission: Required if storing the observation as an event
levels.commit_receipt: Required for durable observation, not for merely proposing display

levels.mapping: Reasoning scope INFERRED_CONSEQUENCE; attribution INFERRED / modality CONDITIONAL or HYPOTHETICAL; Epistemic.POSSIBLE where a finite mapping exists.
levels.memory_observation: ONLY utterance/inference observation, not inferred world fact
levels.evidence: Traceable premises and scope; gaps explicit
levels.host_admission: Required for any separate event effect
levels.commit_receipt: Required for any durable event effect

levels.mapping: Epistemic.SUPPORTED on a scoped typed proposition, or independently supported non-typed source report; other axes remain unchanged.
levels.user_fact: Not directly; candidate then target-specific host admission
levels.task_execution: Support alone is neither authorization nor execution
levels.evidence: Named independently checked source matching proposition/entity/time/scope
levels.certificate: Required only if claiming support under a bounded certified policy
levels.host_admission: Required for every target state effect

levels.mapping: AdmissionController.propose / event_candidates row (EventCandidate governance object); proposed SemanticPlan/Claim is not an admitted event.
levels.next_turn: YES if shown or explicitly identified as host pending proposal; never hidden raw shared history
levels.memory_observation: Candidate persistence is not an admitted observation
levels.evidence: Original source refs plus explicitly missing/required evidence
levels.certificate: Not mandatory for creation; required if selected later policy needs it
levels.host_admission: NO admission inherited; must decide separately
levels.commit_receipt: NO receipt implied by candidate row

levels.mapping: Host-sealed AdmissionDecision.verdict=ADMIT; bounded TrustedState evidence admission is not equivalent to this event decision.
levels.display: YES: precisely admitted, not yet committed
levels.memory_observation: Approved observation; durability still requires commit
levels.user_fact: Only approved report/fact scope, no durable assertion yet
levels.persona: NO direct/Source/Genesis write; no new writer in P2
levels.relationship: Approved supported event may enable existing reducer only after commit
levels.task_execution: Only approved effect; action completion still requires corresponding real action receipt
levels.evidence: Host EvidenceToken/receipt bound to candidate, entity, payload, policy
levels.certificate: Conditional bounded proof, never substitutes for token
levels.host_admission: YES authentic decision, revalidated at commit
levels.commit_receipt: Not yet; required to become DURABLE

levels.mapping: RuntimeStore.commit verified runtime_events/state_versions/index transaction and returned or recovered receipt (RuntimeCommit governance object).
levels.display: YES for the exact committed event/fact scope
levels.memory_observation: YES if admitted observation committed; embedded text keeps lower authority
levels.user_fact: YES only for independently authorized supported target kind; user reports remain reports
levels.persona: Source/Genesis immutable; ordinary P2 has no Persona writer
levels.relationship: Only existing lawful event-derived change; no direct model write
levels.task_execution: Only committed allowed state; external completion requires real controlled action receipt, not DB text
levels.evidence: Retained decision, source/evidence, entity and event chain
levels.certificate: Conditional according to originating finite proof policy
levels.commit_receipt: YES atomic, idempotent and recoverable; receipt scope is exact
